records.title: Parallelgroundtestwarning
records.excerpt: Warning - Please note ! During this test, the ground points and the components to be tested must be subjected to a defined current. Ignition must be turned off! In order to avoid all risks and measurement problems, you must carry out the test without the control unit. The positive pole must remain connected throughout the entire test. Confirm this by selecting Yes . Yes No

records.title: Parallelmessurementwarning
records.excerpt: Warning - Please note ! Ignition off during all work on the control unit !!! The control unit must be connected by way of the plug to the wiring harness. Caution: In event of fault indication (measurement marked red) Check the component and the supply lead with the measuring tools. In the case of 62-pin control unit connections, cable 901 must also be connected. Measuring errors may occur with parallel measurement of

records.title: Parallelstatustestwarning
records.excerpt: Warning - Please note ! The control unit must be connected by way of the connector to the wiring harness. A quick overview of the most important measurement data in the system appears. No scheduled data are displayed in this test --> Start the engine or actuate the starter motor during the measurement OK
